proposals.evidence: DEDR 4395 explicitly analyzes Kota pe-mog woman under pe- female; DEDR 4616 independently gives Kota mog child/wife and pe-mog woman with the cross-reference to 4395. The survey pemagu preserves a final-vowel difference, but both ordered constituents are documented. Propose female (4395) + child/person (4616), retaining the full source response rather than linking it only to peṇ.
